summary: Aera Energy LLC is a natural gas and oil exploration and production company headquartered in Bakersfield, California, jointly owned by Shell Oil Company and ExxonMobil. The note describes it as a California limited liability company and one of the state's largest oil and natural gas producers, with approximate 2015 revenues of over $2 billion. It is operated as a stand-alone company through its board of managers.
